formal_statement: have x1 : (Fin (8 : ℕ) → Bool) → Bool := fun (x1 : Fin (8 : ℕ) → Bool) => x1 (0 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) && x1 (1 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) || x1 (1 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) && x1 (2 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) || x1 (2 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) && x1 (3 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) || x1 (0 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) && x1 (4 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) || x1 (1 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) && x1 (5 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) || x1 (2 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) && x1 (6 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) || x1 (3 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) && x1 (7 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) || x1 (4 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) && x1 (6 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) || x1 (5 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) && x1 (7 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) || x1 (7 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) && x1 (4 : Fin (8 : ℕ)); ∀ (x2 x3 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (x4 : ℕ) (x5 : Bool),   PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo x2 →     PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo x3 →       x2.size + x3.size ≤ (13 : ℕ) →         (8 : ℕ) ≤ x4 →           x4 < (8 : ℕ) + x2.size →             have x11 : (Fin (8 : ℕ) → Bool) → List Bool := fun (x11 : Fin (8 : ℕ) → Bool) => x2.wires (List.ofFn x11);             have x12 : (Fin (8 : ℕ) → Bool) → Bool := fun (x12 : Fin (8 : ℕ) → Bool) => (x11 x12).getD x4 Bool.false;             (∀ (x13 : Fin (8 : ℕ) → Bool), x1 x13 = Bool.false → (x13 (0 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) || x13 (3 : Fin (8 : ℕ))) = Bool.true → x12 x13 = !x5) → (∀ (x14 : Fin (8 : ℕ) → Bool), x3.eval (x11 x14 ++ [x12 x14]) = x1 x14) → ∃ (x15 : Fin (8 : ℕ) → Bool), x3.eval (x11 x15 ++ [x5]) ≠ (x1 x15 || x15 (0 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) || x15 (3 : Fin (8 : ℕ)))
plain_statement: Let g be the edge function of the 8-vertex graph left when vertex 4 is removed from the Petersen graph minus a vertex. For circuits A on the eight inputs and B on A's wires plus one extra wire, at most 13 gates together, a gate wire h of A and a constant b such that h differs from b wherever g is false and x_0 or x_3 is on: if B computes g when the extra wire carries h, then B fails somewhere to compute g OR x_0 OR x_3 when it carries b.
title: A step toward: A step toward: Petersen graph minus a vertex: no AND, OR (fan-in two), NOT circuit with at most 15 gates and first gate NOT x_4 computes its edge
